triples.tail_surface: accessible at all times for maintenance
triples.evidence_text: For single common-main bilge systems, the control valves required in the branches from the bilge main are to be accessible at all times for maintenance.

triples.head_surface: bilge lines leading into the machinery space
triples.head_canonical_zh: 通往机舱的舱底水管路
triples.tail_surface: blanked off or closed off by lockable valves
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 用盲板隔断或用可锁阀门关闭
triples.evidence_text: Whenever flammable liquids with flash point of less than 23°C or toxic liquids are carried in the cargo spaces, the bilge lines leading into the machinery space are to be blanked off or closed off by lockable valves.
